```go
func (m *Map) SetPath(path string, value interface{}) *Map {
    if m.err != nil { return m }
    parts := strings.Split(path, ".")
    if len(parts) == 0 { m.err = ...; return m }
    cur := m.data
    for _, p := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
        next, ok := cur[p]
        if !ok {
            nm := map[string]interface{}{}
            cur[p] = nm
            cur = nm
            continue
        }
        nm, ok := next.(map[string]interface{})
        if !ok {
            m.err = fmt.Errorf("%w at %q: expected map, got %T", ErrTypeMismatch, p, next)
            return m
        }
        cur = nm
    }
    cur[parts[len(parts)-1]] = unwrap(value)
    return m
}
```

func deepCopy(v interface{}) interface{} {

    case map[string]interface{}:

        for k, vv := range x { n[k] = deepCopy(vv) }
        return n
    case []interface{}:
        n := make([]interface{}, len(x))
        for i, vv := range x { n[i] = deepCopy(vv) }
        return n
    default:
        return v
    }
}
```

Done. New Go module `github.com/example/chainmap` with a fluent, chainable API over `map[string]interface{}`.

Key pieces:
- `map.go` — `Map` type: `New`, `ParseJSON`, `Get`/`Path`, `Set`/`SetPath`/`Delete`/`DeletePath`, `Keys`/`Values`/`Each`/`Transform`/`Filter`/`Merge`/`Clone`.
- `value.go` — `Value` wrapper with coercing accessors (`String`, `Int`, `Float64`, `Bool` + `*Or` defaults), nested `Get`/`Index`/`Path`, and `Map()`/`Slice()` casts.
- `slice.go` — `Slice` type: `Index`, `Append`, `Prepend`, `Each`, `Transform`, `Filter`.
- `errors.go` — sentinel errors (`ErrNotFound`, `ErrIndexOutOfRange`, `ErrTypeMismatch`).

Design choice: errors are accumulated along a chain and read once via `Err()` (standard `errors.Is` works), so calls never panic.

```
name := chainmap.New(data).Path("user.profile.name").StringOr("anonymous")
list.Append("x").Transform(...)
